Senior & graduation photography in Provo & Orem

More than the cap and gown.

Bring the outfit you feel best in, the things that matter to you, and a little excitement for what’s next. We can make classic graduation portraits and images that feel more personal—outdoors, with architectural texture, or in a setting connected to your story.

Before we meet

A few good questions.

Can we plan photos around BYU or UVU graduation?

Yes. Tell me your graduation date and when you need the photographs for announcements. We’ll agree on a session date and delivery timeline before you book.

Can I bring a friend or family member?

You’re welcome to bring someone to help with outfits and cheer you on. If you want a shared photo session, tell me how many graduates will be participating so I can quote the right amount of time.

What should I bring?

Bring your cap and gown, cords or stole, comfortable shoes for walking, and any meaningful small props. Check the graduation photo checklist in the journal for more ideas.
